moments.title: I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here! Returns
moments.blurb: Ant & Dec return to Australia as 'I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here!' launches its 26th series on ITV on Monday 16th November at 9pm.

angles.name: General Launch Excitement
angles.copy: The wait is almost over! I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here! kicks off Monday night. Grab your snacks, Ant & Dec are back in the jungle!

angles.name: Football Delay Mention
angles.copy: That's why your Monday night is sorted! I'm A Celeb was delayed by a day for Sunday's England vs Spain match, but now it's time for the jungle fun.

angles.name: Line-up Speculation
angles.copy: Who's heading into camp for I'm A Celeb 2026? Rumours are flying, from Wayne Rooney to Ricky Wilson. Who are you hoping to see?

moments.title: England vs Spain UEFA Nations League
moments.blurb: England takes on Spain in the UEFA Nations League on Sunday 15th November 2026, a high-stakes fixture that led to the I'm A Celeb launch delay.

angles.name: Match Build-up
angles.copy: Big football Sunday! England face Spain in the UEFA Nations League. Can the Three Lions get a crucial win?

angles.name: Why I'm A Celeb is Monday
angles.copy: This is why I'm A Celeb is on Monday! England vs Spain live on Sunday night. Who are you backing?

moments.title: Jamie Miller holds UK Singles Chart No.1
moments.blurb: Jamie Miller's 'Babydoll' remains at number one on the Official UK Singles Chart for an eleventh consecutive week, as of November 7th, 2026.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Still number one! Jamie Miller's 'Babydoll' reigns supreme on the UK Singles Chart for an incredible 11th week.

angles.name: Long Reign
angles.copy: Can anyone knock Jamie Miller off the top spot? 'Babydoll' is officially a chart phenomenon!

moments.title: Queens of the Stone Age top UK Album Chart
moments.blurb: Queens of the Stone Age debut at number one on the Official UK Albums Chart with their new album 'Perfecth', as of November 7th, 2026.

angles.name: New Album Chart King
angles.copy: Queens of the Stone Age crash into Number 1 on the UK Albums Chart with 'Perfecth'! A huge week for rock music.

angles.name: Rock's Reign
angles.copy: New album 'Perfecth' by Queens of the Stone Age is this week's UK Number 1 album! What's your favourite track?

moments.title: Liverpool vs Manchester United Clash
moments.blurb: Two of English football's biggest rivals, Liverpool and Manchester United, face off at Anfield on Sunday 22nd November 2026.

angles.name: Rivalry Buzz
angles.copy: It's the ultimate showdown! Liverpool host Manchester United next Sunday. Who will take the bragging rights?

angles.name: Key Premier League Fixture
angles.copy: Mark your calendars for next Sunday: Liverpool vs Manchester United at Anfield. A massive Premier League fixture you won't want to miss.

angles.name: Local Festivities

angles.name: UK's Biggest Markets

angles.name: UK Destination
